The requirement each town must meet (minimum unit capacity, land area, station-area share), not what it zoned. Capacity is a zoning capacity, not a forecast of homes.

A status list, not a measure of homes: compliance means zoning was adopted and approved, not that anything was built. Interim compliance means an application is in review. HLC posts a new file name for each update, so the address in assumptions/ma_intake.yaml must be updated by hand. www.mass.gov refuses scripted requests (HTTP 403 on 2026-11-24); the build respects that and reads a copy saved by hand as data/raw/local/ma/mbta3a_compliance_status.csv, or else builds the status table from the 3A atlas alone (compliant towns only).
